status: proposed; not run; Phase 4 input from packet S7 (MIDI note storage)
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3, macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin the Live executable and preferences hash before the sitting; fresh preferences
Retain every input file, its SHA-256, Log.txt, a capture of the clip's note editor and any re-saved file
Load each clip by dragging the .alc into an empty MIDI track; save as a new set to obtain the re-saved notes

probes.question: Does a MidiNoteEvent that omits Time, Duration, Velocity or OffVelocity take the previous note's value in the same KeyTrack?
probes.existing_evidence: Array loader 0x101560424 reuses one AMidiNoteEvent (s7-0001); reset 0x1028e2fcc touches only VelocityDeviation, Probability, IsEnabled (s7-0002)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Static derivation of a surprising inheritance; the re-saved values show the effective result
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; KeyTrack MidiKey 36: remove Velocity from its 2nd note; variant: remove Duration; variant: remove Velocity from the 1st note
probes.discriminating_observation: Re-saved 2nd note Velocity equals the 1st note's (85), not 100 or 127; 1st-note variant re-saves 127 (FLT_MAX clamped)

probes.question: Does a NoteId omitted after a non-zero NoteId make the clip fail as corrupt, while a clip with every NoteId omitted opens with fresh ids?
probes.existing_evidence: Inheritance as PRB-S7-01; duplicate check and throw in 0x1028f5864 (s7-0001); zero ids collected out (0x1028f6154) and reassigned (0x1028f6664)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Top-level catch and user-visible outcome not traced
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; variant A: remove NoteId from the 2nd note of KeyTrack 36; variant B: remove every NoteId; variant C: give two notes NoteId 7
probes.discriminating_observation: A and C: error, clip not loaded, capture dialog; B: opens, re-saved NoteIds 1..n in KeyTrack order then time order and NextId n+1 (or the original NextId if larger)

probes.question: Are out-of-range note values clamped on load and saved clamped?
probes.existing_evidence: Post-load 0x1028e2c80 (s7-0001); clamps act only when the load-context flag +0x2c is set (inferred set for documents)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Flag value for document loads inferred, not traced
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; one note each: Velocity 0, Velocity 300, OffVelocity -5, OffVelocity 200, Probability 1.5, Probability -1, Duration -2

probes.question: Is an off-grid Time or Duration re-saved on the 1/3,843,840 grid?
probes.existing_evidence: Quantizer 0x1028e2e24 (s7-0001); all shipped values are on the grid
probes.why_static_insufficient: Round-trip text depends on writer and grid together
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; first note Time 0.123456789 and Duration 0.3333333333; second note Time -0.0000002; third note Time -0.0000001
probes.discriminating_observation: Re-saved text 0.123456751581751581, 0.333333333333333315, -0.000000260156510156510156 and -0 (static derivation from 0x1028e2e24 and the n1 writer rule); any other text falsifies the derivation

probes.question: What happens with MidiKey outside 0..127, a missing MidiKey, or two KeyTracks with the same MidiKey?
probes.existing_evidence: Key map writes without a range check: 0x1028f5f74 and 0x1028f5420 (s7-0003, s7-0004); ctor MidiKey -1
probes.why_static_insufficient: Out-of-bounds store in the reference; outcome may be a crash or silent corruption
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; variants: MidiKey 128; MidiKey -1; MidiKey element removed; two KeyTracks both MidiKey 36. Run in a disposable session
probes.discriminating_observation: Open succeeds or fails or crashes; for duplicates, which notes are shown and re-saved
probes.stopping_condition: Four opens or first crash; stop

probes.question: Are notes in a KeyTrack re-sorted when the document lists them out of time order, and are same-key overlaps kept?
probes.existing_evidence: No sort found after load (generic post-load on AKeyTrack and the array); writer emits array order (0x101560258)
probes.why_static_insufficient: A sort elsewhere (editor or playback model) cannot be excluded statically
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; reverse the note order of KeyTrack 36; add a note overlapping its neighbour on the same key
probes.discriminating_observation: Re-saved order (document order or time order); overlap kept or trimmed; playback of the overlap

probes.question: Per-note expression load: invalid CC, NoteId 0, orphan, duplicate (NoteId, CC), unsorted events, out-of-range Value
probes.why_static_insufficient: User-visible error and re-saved content not observed
probes.minimal_input: Chuck Sutton - Patience (Live 12 Intro Demo).als (SHA-256 f78a98f5dfa1e7bfb334309cb71904d8c4b5b2b0287f9ff1e827abc105fdaea6) or the PRB-S7-01 fixture with one added PerNoteEventList; variants: CC 0; CC 200; NoteId 0; NoteId absent from the clip; two lists with the same NoteId and CC; events in reverse TimeOffset order; CC -2 Value 9000
probes.discriminating_observation: Lists dropped silently (CC 0, CC 200, NoteId 0, orphan); duplicate pair fails to load; events re-saved ascending; Value re-saved 8191

probes.question: Do invalid probability-group ids fail the load?
probes.existing_evidence: 0x1028f5640 and throw at 0x1028f5d0c (s7-0001, s7-0002); no shipped document contains a group
probes.why_static_insufficient: No shipped group exists; group XML shape is schema-only
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; add one NoteProbabilityGroup (GroupType 0, Notes NoteId 1 and 2, Probability 0.5) with GroupId 0, then 5 with ProbabilityGroupIdGenerator NextId 1, then 1 with NextId 2
probes.discriminating_observation: First two fail with an error; third opens; re-saved group text

probes.question: What does a real 12.4.3 save write for notes?
probes.existing_evidence: Writer 0x101486cdc with omit predicate 0x1028e2fe4; number formatters (n1); 12.4d1 shipped files
probes.why_static_insufficient: Shipped files were written by 12.4d1, not 12.4.3
probes.minimal_input: New MIDI clip drawn in 12.4.3: one muted note, one note with probability 50 %, one with velocity deviation +10, one with release velocity 100, one MPE note with pitch-bend and slide envelopes; save
probes.discriminating_observation: Attribute presence and order, number text, KeyTrack order and Ids, NextId value

probes.question: NextId behaviour: smaller than the largest NoteId, larger, negative
probes.existing_evidence: 0x102920db4 raises NextId to max+1 with an unsigned compare (s7-0002)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Effective NextId visible only through a later new note
probes.minimal_input: 909 Core Kit House 127 bpm.alc (App-Resources/Core Library/MIDI Clips/Drums/Drum Machines, SHA-256 79c6ed2f5a46d8ce139e2dae5261285c6894d196e289835f455906e4a901ff59, MinorVersion 12.0_12402, Creator Ableton Live 12.4d1), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip; NoteIdGenerator NextId 1; variant 100000; variant -5
probes.discriminating_observation: Re-saved NextId: max+1, 100000, -5 kept (unsigned -5 is larger) ; a new note drawn after load gets that id
probes.stopping_condition: Three opens with one drawn note each; stop
